roadmap: 09 Advanced sketch — CG3 (fifth bounded item: spline handles, first version)
scope: Spline-tool outlines keep their definition (fit points, closed, optional tangent handle in degrees per fit point) through closing, Finish, reopen, Save/fresh Open; the sketch panel's SPLINE section edits fit point X/Y and handles (Enter/blur); two pieces per span keep side ids; any other edit, dimension or relation turns the curve into an ordinary outline; unbuildable/kernel-inadmissible edits are refused. Viewport handle dragging and handle magnitude are NOT part of D352.

relatedIssues.2051: related (Bezier control-point authoring, non-interpolating); not satisfied by interpolating fit points with tangent handles; stays open
